description: Use when the user asks how good a CS2 player is on FACEIT - level, ELO, country, nickname - or whether a FACEIT account is banned. Returns the FACEIT player object plus known FACEIT bans; players without a FACEIT account return a result saying so - absence is reported explicitly, never silently. Do not use for Steam (VAC/game) bans (steam_bans) or for match history and per-match stats, which SteamGPT does not have.

id.description: any SteamID format: steamid64 (17 digits), STEAM_1:0:x, STEAM_0:0:x, [U:1:x], hex, steam:hex, a 32-bit account id, a steamcommunity.com link or a vanity name

name: steam_faceit

faceit.description: FACEIT player object (nickname, country, games.cs2.skill_level, games.cs2.faceit_elo) or null when no FACEIT profile is known

note.description: present only when no FACEIT profile is known

title: FACEIT profile
